select cp.CREATE_USER_ORG_OU_NAME, cp.FIX_PRICE_STATUS , cl.ORDER_QUANTITY, cl.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_NUM, cl.EXT_BUY_TYPE, cp.CREATED_FULL_NAME, cp.CREATED_BY, cl.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_NUM, cl.ORG_NAME, cl.EXT_USE_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ch.EXT_APPROVE_TIME, cl.MATERIAL_CODE, cl.MATERIAL_NAME, ch.AUDIT_STATUS, cl.EXT_MATERIAL_MODEL, cl.UNIT, cl.BRAND, ce.VENDOR_NAME, cl.REQUIREMENT_DATE, cl.REQUIREMENT_QUANTITY, cl.EXT_CLOSED_CAUSE, ch.AUDIT_STATUS, cl.EXT_POOL_STATUS, cl.EXT_BUY_TYPE, cp.FIX_PRICE_NO, cp.CREATION_DATE from meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier_cooperate.scc_pr_requirement_head ch left join meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier_cooperate.scc_pr_requirement_line cl on ch.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID =cl.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID and ch.EXT_APPROVE_TIME is not null left join meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_fix_price_line ce ON (ce.SOURCE_FROM_ID=cl.EXT_INQ_PROJECT_ID OR ce.SOURCE_FROM_NO=cl.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID) AND ce.ITEM_ID=cl.MATERIAL_ID left join meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_fix_price_head cp on cp.FIX_PRICE_HEAD_ID=ce.FIX_PRICE_HEAD_ID where cl.FIX_PRICE_STATUS='PRICE_END'
and cp.CREATE_USER_ORG_OU_NAME like concat('%',#{createUserOrgOuName},'%')
and cp.CREATED_BY like concat('%',#{createdBy},'%')
and cp.CREATED_FULL_NAME like concat('%',#{createdFullName},'%')
and cl.ORG_NAME like concat('%',#{orgName},'%')
and cl.EXT_CLOSED_CAUSE like concat('%',#{extClosedCause},'%')
and cl.EXT_USE_DEPARTMENT_NAME like concat('%',#{extUseDepartmentName},'%')
and cl.MATERIAL_CODE like concat('%',#{materialCode},'%')
and ce.VENDOR_NAME like concat('%',#{vendorName},'%')
and ch.EXT_APPROVE_TIME >= concat(#{beginTime},' 00:00:00')
and ch.EXT_APPROVE_TIME <= concat(#{endTime},' 23:59:59')
and cp.CREATED_BY=#{jobNumber}

and cp.CREATED_BY like concat('%',#{createdBy},'%')
and cp.CREATED_FULL_NAME like concat('%',#{createdFullName},'%')
and cl.ORG_NAME like concat('%',#{orgName},'%')
and cl.EXT_CLOSED_CAUSE like concat('%',#{extClosedCause},'%')
and cl.EXT_USE_DEPARTMENT_NAME like concat('%',#{extUseDepartmentName},'%')
and cl.MATERIAL_CODE like concat('%',#{materialCode},'%')
and ce.VENDOR_NAME like concat('%',#{vendorName},'%')
and ch.EXT_APPROVE_TIME >= concat(#{beginTime},' 00:00:00')
and ch.EXT_APPROVE_TIME <= concat(#{endTime},' 23:59:59')
and cp.CREATED_BY=#{jobNumber}
group by cp.CREATED_BY
